description: This file contains unit tests for the function 'resolveConversationIdFromTargets', which is imported from 'conversation-id.js'. The tests verify the function's behavior with various target input formats to extract conversation IDs, including channel IDs, room IDs, group IDs, direct messages, Discord mentions, and numeric IDs.
